verdict.reasons: The candidate image successfully displays the expected white-and-blue upright cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton roll with authentic, readable branding and the required watermark. The technical evidence of a pressure gauge is present, aligning with the article's focus on pressure control. Minor advisory warnings include an inconsistency in the color of the flattened drip tape lateral (it appears black rather than the white expected from the carton roll) and the gauge is shown freestanding in the soil rather than explicitly connected to the header pipe as detailed in the text. These are not core defects and do not violate the minimum quality threshold.

focused_physical_review.reason: The continuous white drip tape emerges directly from the side of the white-and-blue AFP package, physically touching the boundary of the carton, which confirms line_touches_or_crosses_package=true. While the black loop and pressure gauge are clearly positioned to the right, they are part of the continuous installed lateral system rather than a distinct uninstalled or loose secondary coil, meaning extra_loose_product_coil=false. The carton sides are smooth and intact with no visible ribbon, strap, or tape tails emerging, leaving package_has_protruding_strip=false.
